questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

125 : 27 :: 216 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

125 : 27 → 5³ : (5 – 2)³

Similarly,

216 : ? → 6³ : (6 – 2)³

? = 4³ = 64

Hence, ‘64’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some chairs are doors.

II. All doors are tables.

**Conclusion I:** Some chairs are tables.

**Conclusion II: **No doors are chairs.

**Conclusion III:** Some tables are doors.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follows.
Only conclusion I and II follows.
Only conclusion I and III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcdc195fba009c878b9b2f3c50a842b2a51dbd0ee44ce9af6c753c889f908c83.png] 

**Conclusion I:** Some chairs are tables. → True

**Conclusion II: **No doors are chairs. → False

**Conclusion III:** Some tables are doors. → True

Hence, ‘only conclusion I and III follows’.

questions.question:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

6 ÷ 3 + 12 × 4 - 9 = 12
questions.solution:
Given equation: 6 ÷ 3 + 12 × 4 - 9 = 12

1) -, ×

After interchanging ‘-, x’, we get:

L.H.S = 6 ÷ 3 + 12 - 4 × 9

= 2 + 12 – 36

= 14 – 36

= - 22 ≠ R.H.S

2) ÷, ×

After interchanging ‘÷, ×’, we get:

L.H.S = 6 × 3 + 12 ÷ 4 - 9

= 18 + 3 – 9

= 21 – 9

= 12 = R.H.S

3) -, +

After interchanging ‘-, +’, we get:

L.H.S = 6 ÷ 3 - 12 × 4 + 9

= 2 – 48 + 9

= 11 – 48

= -37 ≠ R.H.S

4) +, ÷

After interchanging ‘+, ÷’, we get:

L.H.S = 6 + 3 ÷ 12 × 4 - 9

= 6 + 0.25 × 4 – 9

= 6 + 1 – 9

= 7 – 9

= -2 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, ‘÷, ×’ is the correct answer

questions.question: Five girls Ashi, Binita, Laila, Diksha, Isha read a magazine. The one who reads first gives it to Laila. The one who reads last had taken from Ashi. Isha was not the first or last to read. There were two readers between Binita and Ashi. Who read the magazine first?
questions.solution:
1. Five girls Ashi, Binita, Laila, Diksha, Isha read a magazine.

2. The one who reads first gives it to Laila.

3. The one who reads last had taken from Ashi.

4. Isha was not the first or last to read. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/080323024f4e3b27a39ef93df6168da4479466794bcc63d5b50e56a5cc03c935.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7e0ab4cf0537ba4d864d89f48695fc8b3aef9179a3e182ae47bf88e2bd4e64d.png] 

As ‘Isha was not the first or last to read’, so Isha takes the 3rd position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db6d320370352b52c49462ee95af739e84c2ac0cfd4db8690dc08d8f4ab5810d.png] 

Now, Diksha will occupy the only left position in the arrangement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7df1c1bffca02ff0ff4424a307594ad6cf72eb8d34859a0ed9df3560bb90773a.png] 

Hence, Binita read the magazine first.
